title.narrative: GEAR UP! - Global citizenship Education Actions to stRenghten yoUth engagement through local support to LAs and CSOs, to accelerate Progress towards sustainable development

description.narrative: Contract related to: GEAR UP! - Global citizenship Education Actions to stRenghten yoUth engagement through local support to LAs and CSOs, to accelerate Progress towards sustainable development - The Development Education and Awareness Raising (DEAR) Programme contributes to the geopolitical objectives of the Commission, building the support of EU citizens, particularly youth, for sustainable development and cooperation with partner countries. It aims at changing behaviour, notably by promoting solidarity and encouraging active citizenship engagement for the achievement of the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), showing EU people¿s determination to act for the global collective interest.The present Action, under the Global Challenges Thematic Programme 2021-2027, proposes to implement the DEAR Programme through one action, hence 100% of the funding under this Action Document will flow to the Call for Proposals in the area of DEAR (Action 1). Action 1 is a large Call for Proposals for Local Authority (LA) led projects covering all the specific objectives of the MAAP. Special attention will be paid to target young people and ensure the participation of youth organisations. The action will contribute to SDG 4 (Education), and in particular SDG Target 4.7. (by 2030 ensure all learners acquire knowledge and skills needed to promote sustainable development, including among others through education for sustainable development and sustainable lifestyles, human rights, gender equality, promotion of a culture of peace and non-violence, global citizenship, and appreciation of cultural diversity and of culture¿s contribution to sustainable development).
